cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Fair Means I Can Win
cards.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've joined you up here. A fair starting position for the race.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the starter. I stand ahead so the runners can see my flag.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely. I should see it just as clearly as everyone else.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stand anywhere on that line. You're all racing to the oak tree over on the left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the left end is mine. Same line for everyone; no need to equalize the distance as well.
